dedupe_keys.name: constructing dataset of classified drainage areas based on surface water supply patterns in high mountain asia

description: Lu and colleagues publish classified drainage areas across High Mountain Asia according to glacier and stream supply. The 4TU record identifies four classes with 87, 107, 32 and 448 drainage areas, and lists a README, a ZIP dataset and a KML file. Its own page gives CC0 rights and a version-1 DOI. Science Data Bank hosts a matching PUBLIC, CC0 mirror under another DOI. The classes can help water-supply or hydropower simulations distinguish basins fed by glaciers, streams, both or neither when setting source assumptions. They are static catchment classifications, not observed discharge or forecasts. The provider metadata gives time coverage as 2006/2010, but does not say that the classification is a time series. The article and provider pages use different abbreviations for the four classes; the counts and class meanings agree. Basin geometry, coordinate reference and ZIP contents were not checked because no resource files were downloaded. A modeller should inspect the geometry before joining these classes to an asset network.
